$comment: G-98 settings screen text (O5, O6.6.1: strings live in template files). label.<key> names a setting; settings.<key> is its one-line explanation (the schema's help id); option.<value> names an enum option.

strings.screen.title: Settings
strings.screen.fixed_creation: Fixed when the career was created
strings.screen.no_network: This version makes no network calls. Saves and settings stay on this machine.
strings.screen.no_difficulty: There is one difficulty: real life. No setting changes how good anyone is.
strings.screen.clock_rule: The play clock always runs in a game. These settings change only what you watch while no decision is yours.
strings.settings.display.theme: Light, dark or high contrast. System follows the operating system.
strings.settings.display.windowMode: Run in a window or full screen.
strings.settings.display.interfaceScale: Size of the whole interface, 80% to 200%. Above 150% in a small window the console uses its compact layout.
strings.settings.display.fieldOrientation: Which way the field view faces.
strings.settings.display.markerSize: Size of the player markers on the field view.
strings.settings.display.frameCap: Draw playback at the display rate or half of it. Changes drawing only.
strings.settings.display.performanceTier: Low, standard or high drawing detail. Never changes a result.
strings.settings.audio.masterOn: Turns all sound on or off.
strings.settings.audio.whistleCrowdVolume: Volume of the whistle, snap and crowd.
strings.settings.audio.whistleCrowdOn: Turns the whistle, snap and crowd cues on or off.
strings.settings.audio.alertsOn: Turns alert sounds on or off.
strings.settings.audio.playClockTickVolume: Volume of the tick under 10 seconds on the play clock.
strings.settings.audio.menuMusicOn: Music on the menu and career screens. Off by default.
strings.settings.audio.playClockTickOn: A tick when the play clock is under 10 seconds. The clock pulses on screen either way.
strings.settings.controls.keyProfile: The key profile in use. Left hand only is included.
strings.settings.controls.keyOverrides: Keys you changed from the default. Change them on the Keys page.
strings.settings.accessibility.colourVision: Palettes for protan, deutan and tritan colour vision. Colour is never the only signal.
strings.settings.accessibility.textScale: Text size, separate from the interface scale.
strings.settings.accessibility.thickFieldLines: Thicker yard lines and hash marks on the field view.
strings.settings.accessibility.focusHighlight: Size of the ring around the focused control.
strings.settings.accessibility.reducedMotion: Stills in place of playback and no eased camera. Does not slow the play clock.
strings.settings.accessibility.holdToConfirm: Hold the key to confirm a timeout or challenge, so a stray press does nothing.
strings.settings.accessibility.chordTimeout: How long a key chord waits for its second press. Changes input only, never the clock.
strings.settings.accessibility.stickyModifiers: Press Shift, Ctrl or Alt once and it stays down for the next key.
strings.settings.accessibility.switchScanning: Step through the call sheet with one switch. Changes input only, never the clock.
strings.settings.playback.watch: Every play, your own unit's plays, key plays only, or results only.
strings.settings.playback.speed: Speed of playback. Watching counts against your next call's clock.
strings.settings.playback.stoppageCompression: How long dead time lasts on screen when nothing needs you. Fixed in a certified career.
strings.settings.navigation.favourites: Screens pinned to the favourites strip, up to 12.
strings.settings.navigation.alertLevels: How loudly each kind of alert asks for you.
strings.settings.navigation.layout: Panel sizes and positions you set.
strings.settings.privacy.backupReminder: The browser build offers a download backup after each game week.
strings.settings.mods.enabled: User content packs in use. Locked in a certified career.
strings.settings.gameplay.ruleSetId: The rule book this career uses. Set when the career is created.
strings.settings.gameplay.certified: A certified career keeps the fixed rules of the coaching rating. Set when the career is created.
strings.settings.session.viewStates: Sort orders and open panels remembered until you close the game.
strings.keys.title: Keys
strings.keys.import_skipped: {n} rows with unknown actions were ignored: {list}
strings.act.call.precommit_cycle: Cycle the fourth-down decision made ahead of time
